programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Motorboat
programme.desc: Although Bernard has been shipwrecked, his real problems begin when he finds an abandoned motorboat which could get him back to shore.

programme.title: Bernard - Bernard - The Prisoner
programme.desc: Bernard makes a daring escape from prison, but once he's out, he realises that perhaps life inside wasn't so bad after all.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Brain Candy TV
programme.desc: Early learning for a brighter future! Your children will love to learn their ABCs, numbers, colors and even some math and science with the help of our action-packed vehicles including monster trucks, dump trucks, trains and more, plus our cute dog Lizzy.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Yeti Tales
programme.desc: Join Us in Yeti Tales !

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: A Son
programme.desc: A family’s holiday in Tunisia ends in disaster, when their 10-year-old son Aziz is shot during a terrorist ambush. At the hospital where Aziz is in desperate need of a transplant, the family discovers a long-buried secret.

programme.title: Lost In Marseille
programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: Heart Of A Lion
programme.desc: Teppo, the leader of a gang of neo-nazis, falls in love with Sari. To his shock, Sari’s son is black, and Teppo finds his prejudices and loyalties pitted against his desire for love and family.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows Jealousy
programme.desc: Inspector Bruhl is investigating the abduction of a young boy from a playground, until evidence suggests that the boy doesn’t exist at all. Is he a figment of the alleged mother’s fractured reality, or are answers buried in her traumatic past?

programme.title: Red, White And Brass

programme.desc: Edith is a middle-aged woman, estranged from her son and now about to lose her job as a textile factory worker. With nothing to hold her to her hometown, she decides to move to Morocco where her factory has relocated instead of facing unemployment.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Dialogue

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Party Crashers
programme.desc: Aja attends her first teem party, Krel goes hunting for an urban legend with Eli, but the kids' fun is ruined when the Zeron Brotherhood crash their night. Meanwhile, Vex receives a message from Akiridion-5.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Lightning in a Bottle
programme.desc: In the flipside of Trollhunters Ep. 222, Aja and Krel embark on a journey with Jim, Toby, and Claire, who Krel believes are the Zeron Brotherhood in disguise. Meanwhile, Aja’s missing Serrtaor embarks on a journey of its own.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Dawn Of Destruction
programme.desc: When Hiccup and Astrid go away for a weekend, the Edge is attacked by Krogan, Viggo, and their new Dragon Flyers

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - The Wings Of War Part 1
programme.desc: Hiccup and the riders are on the run from the Flyers, but when they return to Berk, where Stoick is preparing for war, Hiccup is torn between his desire to get the Edge back and his unwillingness to fire on dragons

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - The Wings Of War Part 2
programme.desc: When Stoick decides to take the battle on the Dragon Flyers to the Edge, the Riders must figure out how to trap the Flyers and take back the Edge

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Packet Racket Smack Me Down
programme.desc: When a shady group of bugs moves into the city selling artificial ketchup, Turbo and Shadow go undercover to expose who is behind the operation. After Turbo is challenged to compete in an underground smack-talk contest, he must get lessons from the best insult snail there is, Burn.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Smoovin On Up The Great Shell Robbery
programme.desc: Smoove Move goes from underground street artist to world-famous pedicurist and lets his newfound fame go to his head. Thieving hermit crabs steal the crew's shells, so they concoct an elaborate heist to get them back.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Strutter Sitting Corny-O Chaos
programme.desc: The Strutter siblings hold a yard sale and babysit at the same time. Archibald races for a big prize: a lifetime supply of his favorite cereal.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Moving Train Tracks
programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings is having a fairy picnic in Fable Forest that evening. Everyone offers to help set up for the picnic but Queen Sparklewings tells them not to worry - the fairies can do it all. Later, when Noddy and all his friends are approaching Fable Forest Station on the train they discover someone has redirected the train tracks. They can't get to Fable Forest. How will they have the picnic in time? Noddy needs to investigate why the train tracks have been moved.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The King Of Toyland
programme.desc: Noddy returns from a Make and Take party at Pat-Pat's and finds the Builders are constructing a big orange palace in Toy Green. by order of the King of Toyland! Noddy decides to investigate: who is the mysterious King of Toyland? He spots the Knights carrying a royal litter, but all he can see inside is the top of an orange crown. Realising the King's favourite colour must be orange, Noddy remembers seeing Pat-Pat painting a bowl of oranges and wonders if she knows who the King is.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Flyaway Balloons
programme.desc: Everyone is decorating special balloons in Toyland. They're going to have a big Balloon Release at the end of the day and see how far they can fly. But when Noddy returns in the afternoon with Big Ears, the balloons have already flown away! Noddy decides to investigate. Following all the clues, he arrives at Deltoid's house. The action hero toy tells him that he only took back his specially decorated balloon. The others were still there earlier.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Brick
programme.desc: Noddy and his friends are building a toy tower. Carlton is joining in and having a great time. They've almost finished when one of the brick pieces goes missing! Oh no. How can they finish the tower without the last brick? Noddy needs to investigate. Using his detecting skills Noddy soon finds the missing brick.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Guinea Fowl Has Dots
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Guinea Fowl didn't have dots. She was an adventurous bird and loved to discover things. One day Tortoise challenges her to find out why the top of Mount Tinga Tinga shines. Guinea Fowl can't resist and races off, over the desert, past the ocean, up to the very top of Mount Tinga Tinga where she does indeed discover why the top of Mount Tinga Tinga shines.... SNOW! Guinea Fowl is the first ever animal to see snow! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Buffalo Has Horns
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Buffalo didn't have horns. He had very long shaggy hair and he lived near the Swamp. But then one day the Swamp moves and Buffalo has to find a new home! The Swamp grows and grows and soon all the horned animals who live on the Plains risk losing their home too. So Buffalo decides to save the day and push back the muddy swamp. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat's Pop Star Rescue
programme.desc: Everyone in Greendale is excited because pop superstar, Brad Lee is coming to Pencaster Bay to perform a concert. Unfortunately Brad's luxury private ship has broken down en route so Pat and Jess must head out to sea in the SDS boat and collect him. Meanwhile Julian, Meera, Bill and Sarah are on the train to Pencaster Bay with their mums to watch the concert. The kids enter into a cacophonous ‘sing off' to decide who is the best singer.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Very Important Person
programme.desc: PC Selby is being honoured with a medal for being "Best local Policeman of the year" and Pat is despatched to Pencaster bay to collect both the medal and the person who is going to present it; The Duchess of Pencaster! Somewhat star struck Pat and Jess drive the Duchess towards Pencaster back to the award ceremony at Greendale but at her request they stop to help some of the villagers which unfortunately leads to her getting covered in coal dust and mud!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mr Carburettor's Birthday Suit
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is off to try out his new wetsuit at the beach… it may come in useful when rain is forecast for the big race the next day!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Bangs
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning a big firework display up at the farm. Can Roary help Tin Top overcome his fear of bangs in time for the display?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Pizza
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has demanded pizza for lunch but the pizzeria is closed. How is Marsha going to ensure Mr Carburettor gets the lunch he asked for?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Stars
programme.desc: Roary is feeling put out as all the cars are paying Conrod too much attention. He is determined to show his worth when they race that afternoon. But tries too hard and ends up in danger. Who can save him?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Pockets
programme.desc: Pat-Pat wants to play detective for the day with Noddy, but the only problem is that they don't have a case to solve... that is until the Pockets go missing. Where can they be? It's up to Noddy and Pat Pat to investigate!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Cabbage Monster
programme.desc: When Farmer Tom's cabbages go missing, Pat-Pat thinks there must be a cabbage monster on the loose! Noddy's not so sure but then Driver Dylan tells Noddy he's just seen a monster! What if Pat Pat was right? Noddy investigates: where is the cabbage monster?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Runaway Train
programme.desc: Everyone in Toyland is ready to board Train for the 'Big Day Out', but Train runs off down the tracks without any passengers! Why did Train drive away? Noddy investigates to literally save the day.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of Revs Not Listening
programme.desc: Noddy's excitedly looking forward to his first ever go at driving Train. But then Revs starts playing up and won't listen when Noddy asks him to stop. Why is Revs not listening to him? A puzzled Noddy investigates to find out what's wrong with his friend.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when they’re not around. He follows all the clues which leads him to the Knights.

Did the Naughticorns take them for their obstacle course? Or was it Farmer Tom who used them to keep his animals under control. Noddy carefully follows the clues and at last discovers it was the Pirates who took them to use as markers for Stripes' Pirate Galleon Driving Test.

He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

Puff Adder decides that if no beast wants to be his friend then he doesn't want to have any friends. He slithers far, far away to the desert where he bumps into Camel and learns that every animal needs a friend. Tales from Africa.

Eagle quietly saves the day and Lion rewards her with half his Kingdom. Tales from Africa.

Pat and Jess meet the eccentric Ned Glenn at his workshop and wrestle with the crate containing the heavy engine to get it aboard the plane.

But when he picks them up from Ted's workshop, Jess starts playing with a giant pumpkin and it rolls into the river and floats away. Pat follows it along the river and tries to fish it out with Alf's rod but the pumpkin is too heavy and the line breaks. As the party gets under way in Greendale, the giant pumpkin floats out to sea and Pat and Jess board the SDS Orca and head out into Pencaster Bay.

programme.title: Colourful Life - EP1
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape._x000D__x000D_The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA). The second son, CHI POK (YUEN SIU CHEUNG, LOUIS), is a short-tempered man.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP22
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP23

programme.title: The Conquest - EP15
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP18
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP11
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP21
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP6
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP12
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP2
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP21
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP6
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP12
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP2
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

programme.title: 豬哥亮經典秀第26集
programme.desc: 《豬哥亮經典秀》不僅帶給觀眾歡樂和笑聲，還有許多社會關懷的元素。豬哥亮通過喜劇的形式，闡述對社會現象和人情世故的觀察和思考。他的幽默風格融入了對生活的態度和智慧，使節目更具意義和價值。《豬哥亮經典秀》在台灣電視界享有很高的評價和知名度，成為了豬哥亮的代表作之一。這個節目也讓豬哥亮贏得了許多獎項和觀眾的喜愛，並在他逝世後成為了他不朽的精神財富。

programme.title: 阿叔第25集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工家具修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的家具，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的家具，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從台北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 回到那年老台中第3集
programme.desc: 從台中最早的開發地走起，帶你一同洞悉歷史文化發展 、造訪各項景點，在新舊交融中，玩味台中，認識這塊土地！

programme.title: 體壇菁典E啟動第5集
programme.desc: 教育部體育署推動的「體育運動文化數位典藏」計畫，旨在蒐集、數位化臺灣百年體育歷史文物，並訪談具貢獻的體壇人物。

programme.title: 南投資深藝術家第2集
programme.desc: 許多資深藝術家來自南投，他們也致力於推廣及傳承，不僅僅是藝術技法，藝術精神的流傳更是一項在地重要的文化資產。藉由簡介、創作理念、心路歷程、藝術教育推廣，其對於南投藝文發展的參與及敘述等面向，邀請觀眾一同進入豐富的藝術饗宴。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第254集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2025安樂富有經論講座第8集
programme.desc: 你是否希望在繁忙的生活中找到更多的安寧與富足？你是否渴望擁有智慧的指引，提升人生的質量？我們誠摯邀請您參加 「安樂富有經論講座」，開啟您探索內心和平與富足的智慧之旅！

programme.title: 人生調色盤第254集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 大雲時堂第18集
programme.desc: 廣邀政壇、商界等各領域優秀人士齊聚食堂，與主持人暢談話題、聊生活趨勢，把您想知道、不知道、感興趣的事如一道道好菜端上您面前。

programme.title: 名人書房第75集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 生活智多星第1731集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第270集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 超級總動員寶貝萬花筒第11集
programme.desc: 節目邀請同學、好友、兄弟姊妹及親子共同組團，展現多樣的才藝與默契。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第74集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第292集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 熟年第32集
programme.desc: 張春梅生活在外人看來堪稱完美，變故出現在倪老太太的壽宴，張春梅的老公、倪家的小兒子倪偉強居然無故缺席，而且電話失聯…

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第13集
programme.desc: 突破一般記錄報導影片，平實卻易流於平淡無味的刻板手法，另類開創了戶外探險、旅遊行腳節目，深度好看、知性感性兼顧，又能將文字與音樂有如行雲流水般的自然融入，重要的是，我們及時保存下許多消逝的聲音、消逝的物種、消逝的故事…

programme.title: 真料理兩鍋論第3集
programme.desc: 節目中主持人們將分為兩組PK對決，親自出馬找尋稀有食材、超強主廚及傳奇秘方與菜單，獻上最美味的完美料理。

programme.title: 百萬小學堂第347集
programme.desc: 讀碩士難？還是回答小孩的題目難？答不出碩士班考題理所當然，但答不出小學程度的問題該怎麼辦？台視製播益智節目，由曾寶儀和小蝦聯手主持、薛聖棻製作，邀請各行業精英前來挑戰小學生的問題，連過十關便可贏得高額獎金！

programme.title: FOOD超人第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 講述著以中華食物作為設計元素的FOOD超人與他的伙伴們保護著一個食物小鎮叫FOOD島，最厲害的超人Food超人與最愛髒亂的蒼蠅王到底會有什麼趣事發生?

programme.title: 益起看世界第414集
programme.desc: 每天發生的國際要聞需要深度解析，從最新科技知識到各地人文風情，從影響深遠的國際衝突到全球政經局勢發展，結合在地觀點、全球視野與台視新聞團隊的國際新聞專業，要帶給您不一樣的第一手報導。邀請您益起看世界，開拓您的國際視野。

programme.title: 魔蹤傳奇第9集

programme.title: 閱讀時光Ⅱ妖精口述影像版第1集
programme.desc: 一通越洋電話，劃破了家裡的寧靜。晚飯餐桌上，淑英準備了滿桌佳餚，像是想慶祝什麼似的，讓許久不曾同桌吃飯的兒子語軒跟老公漢忠如坐針氈。淑英故作輕鬆地聊起關於「那女人」的事，漢忠只是靜靜地聽著。那天夜裡，漢忠徹底失眠了。他摸黑走進倉庫翻箱倒櫃，焦急地想找著，找著與梓雲的回憶，找著兩人曾經相知相愛的蛛絲馬跡，他渴望能找回一點什麼都好…但翻找到的，卻是與淑英兩人當年的結婚照，回過神來，發現淑英站在背後，冷眼地看著他。

programme.title: 伴你同行第5集
programme.desc: 倪國俊在很年輕時憑著自己努力，擁有三家咖啡連鎖店及設計公司，新婚後不久發現罹患僵直性脊椎炎，四處胡亂求診延誤治療，妻子因此離開他，他人生陷入低潮，並自我封閉，生活陷入絕境。在最痛苦時，慈濟人伸出援手，有如母親的喜久師姊一路陪伴，兩人從陌生人成為亦友亦母子的情誼，喜九喪子的苦痛經歷也因此揭開而來，兩人相知相惜，也豐富了彼此的心靈。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第174集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人書房第12集

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第255集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第55集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1438集
programme.desc: 以 證嚴上人出門行腳各地的隨緣開示為內容，近距離同霑一代宗師的法髓甘露與清淨智慧。以真實記錄譜寫現代阿含經，使全球大眾如同親隨。

programme.title: 映照人生第499集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 人文講堂第595集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第174集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 大愛影展第170集
programme.desc: 精選近幾年來在台灣大銀幕上映，擁有教化人心、帶給人心靈收穫的日本、韓國電影，希望透過每周一集的電影內容，傳遞美善的信念以及溫暖人心的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第255集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第25集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 草根菩提第4058集
programme.desc: 有一群人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人「用鼓掌雙手做環保」的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念、數字或儀器。這是一群很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 行動現場第499集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 月娘第5集
programme.desc: 薛月，一個哈瑪星魚市場大盤商家的千金小姐，平日喜歡去看歌仔戲及追星的浪漫女孩。講義氣又愛布施，傳承自種公益田做善事的父親。 頗有佛緣的她，曾經夢見自己是觀世音菩薩旁的侍女，因而想出家修行，令薛家父母忙著替她相親找對象。然而阿月自有愛情的憧憬，不論出身好壞，只要彼此心靈契合，她相信就能廝守一生。 就這樣，阿月遇見了在左營軍樂隊服役的鄭添吉，兩人因樂曲而相知相戀，阿月眼中，他就像是戲裡貧窮卻不失志的小生，阿月相信只要相愛，就能突破困頓，迎向幸福。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第81集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.desc: 在日本昭和年代，傳統觀念認為女人必須走進家庭、相夫教子。但女主角寅子（伊藤沙莉飾）卻無懼禁忌，不僅考進大學研讀法律，更成為日本第一位女律師！爾後她為了幫助在戰爭中受到苦難的孩童與女性，努力奔走成立家事法院，並且打破歧視，擔任日本首位女法官……

programme.title: 月娘第6集
programme.desc: 薛月，一個哈瑪星魚市場大盤商家的千金小姐，平日喜歡去看歌仔戲及追星的浪漫女孩。講義氣又愛布施，傳承自種公益田做善事的父親。 頗有佛緣的她，曾經夢見自己是觀世音菩薩旁的侍女，因而想出家修行，令薛家父母忙著替她相親找對象。然而阿月自有愛情的憧憬，不論出身好壞，只要彼此心靈契合，她相信就能廝守一生。 就這樣，阿月遇見了在左營軍樂隊服役的鄭添吉，兩人因樂曲而相知相戀，阿月眼中，他就像是戲裡貧窮卻不失志的小生，阿月相信只要相愛，就能突破困頓，迎向幸福。

programme.title: 365日日素第179集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第506集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第577集
programme.desc: 在日本昭和年代，傳統觀念認為女人必須走進家庭、相夫教子。但女主角寅子（伊藤沙莉飾）卻無懼禁忌，不僅考進大學研讀法律，更成為日本第一位女律師！爾後她為了幫助在戰爭中受到苦難的孩童與女性，努力奔走成立家事法院，並且打破歧視，擔任日本首位女法官……

programme.title: 大愛真健康第947集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6774集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 中視強檔電影院-怪醫杜立德第2集
programme.desc: 杜立德醫生擁有一個幸福的家庭，一個小有名氣的診所，沒有人知道他曾經有著異常的經歷，那就是能夠聽懂動物的說話。小時候，他就和貓狗馬驢之類的動物交談過，了解動物的需要，知道它們的心事。隨著歲數增長，杜立德醫生早已失去了這個特異功能。然而，他卻因為一次開車差點撞上路邊的小狗，似乎又能聽到了小狗罵他笨蛋。這下子杜立德的生活可熱鬧起來了，因為他沈睡已久的動物語言天賦又被重新喚醒，阿貓阿狗不但成為了他的朋友，還主動找上門來找杜立德醫生看病。診所變成了熙熙攘攘的動物世界，而生意也因此陷入低迷。人人都以為杜立德瘋了，家人對他的行為也非常的不理解，杜立德醫生和他的診所面臨著不小的挑戰。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第659集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第40集

programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神秘的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神秘力量。故事圍繞著一群英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心弦，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神秘的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 哈士奇第12集
programme.desc: 他是舞台上風光的蒙面摔角選手，也是生活中手忙腳亂的單親爸爸—大哈。獨自把兒子小哈養大，是他最驕傲、也最困難的挑戰 。大哈希望成為小哈心中值得崇拜的爸爸，有時候卻因用力過猛，做出讓人哭笑不得的脫線行為。小哈看在眼裡，無奈在心裡，父子間的日常互動，就在一件件瑣事中碰撞出笑點與溫度， 在歡笑與拌嘴間，兩人一起慢慢變成更好的自己！

programme.title: 只此一家第49集
programme.desc: 馬麗敏是房地產公司「只此一家」的老闆娘，心中懷抱成功的宏大目標。 她帶著兒子郝仁品在地產界闖蕩，母子聯手在競爭激烈的市場中一步步站穩腳步。 丈夫郝健則與室內設計師萬德福合力經營「好運裝修公司」，專責裝修與設計事務。 兩家公司互相配合，一家人齊心協力，幫助客戶們打造理想中的家。 他們也在與不同客戶的接觸過程中，見證了各式各樣與「家」相關的人生百態。

programme.title: 包青天第98集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 全新版本的哆啦A夢變得更小巧可愛，其他角色也有些微的變化，但故事依舊充滿趣味！故事開始時，我們認識到一個運動神經不佳、考試總是拿零分、超級懶散又愛睡覺的小學生-野比大雄。有一天，一隻貓型機器人【哆啦Ａ夢】乘坐時光機從二十二世紀來到了大雄的房間。原來，這是大雄的曾孫【小世修】為了改變大雄悲慘的人生，特地將【哆啦Ａ夢】送到他身邊。

programme.title: 舊情綿綿第10集
programme.desc: 這是一個恩怨情仇，前後糾葛了四十餘年的故事。台灣光復前後，嘉義布袋大地主之子顏海豬、燒炭工的兒子汪邦雄，與佃農的女兒林桂蓮，這三個身分地位懸殊的童年玩伴，因為現實的捉弄而走上不同的命運。

programme.title: 火車來去第14集
programme.desc: 講述1983年臺南縣，一個平凡而不平庸的小鎮故事，有親情、友情、愛情的酸甜苦澀，鎮上的火車來了，有人上車，遠去他鄉奮鬥、有人下車，回到故鄉探親，火車來去，乘載了人生悲歡離合的故事，串起了你我的記憶。 家的期待是否能成真？來到鎮上的陌生老者王董，跟這一切又有什麼關聯？火車來去，南來北往，是開心啟程還是悵然離鄉？走過火車來去的歲月，滿是鹹酸苦汫的人生。

programme.title: 火車來去第15集
programme.desc: 講述1983年臺南縣，一個平凡而不平庸的小鎮故事，有親情、友情、愛情的酸甜苦澀，鎮上的火車來了，有人上車，遠去他鄉奮鬥、有人下車，回到故鄉探親，火車來去，乘載了人生悲歡離合的故事，串起了你我的記憶。 家的期待是否能成真？來到鎮上的陌生老者王董，跟這一切又有什麼關聯？火車來去，南來北往，是開心啟程還是悵然離鄉？走過火車來去的歲月，滿是鹹酸苦汫的人生。

programme.title: 美味縱貫現第13集
programme.desc: 不但縱橫古今帶您穿透美味裡的歷史傳承，也透過細膩的鏡頭重現精彩廚藝的繁復作工，更深入台灣大城小鎮為觀眾找出健康美味的食材！

programme.title: 我們的島第1353集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 下課花路米第1376集
programme.desc: 針對小學中、高學年生所設計的探索型兒童節目。為了喚起孩子們對台灣的鄉土關懷，節目以「生活台語」和「城鄉探索」為主軸，穿插逗趣幽默的故事情節，以輕鬆的方式帶領孩子了解台灣的歷史、人文、文化。

programme.title: 反正你也不睡覺第42集
programme.desc: 《反正你也不睡覺》是由作家吳曉樂、陳栢青與街訪主持人傑尼共同主持的讀書節目，每週兩天，在線上跟你說一個故事，可能是一本小說、一封陌生人的來信，或邀請大來賓到現場。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第100集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 行走TIT第401集
programme.desc: 台灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新台灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 大腦先生第4集
programme.desc: 透過心理測驗，探索大腦奧秘，以此認識自我！

programme.title: 農村的遠見第1集
programme.desc: 《農村的遠見》是台灣一部2018年的系列紀錄片，由劉嵩導演、林盛豐擔任總策劃，寶花團隊製作，透過借鑑德國、日本、荷蘭、美國和印尼的農村發展，試圖啟發台灣對於土地的想像。第一季共五集，自2018年12月4日起播出，第二季於2019年推出。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第55集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在台灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 荒野六季-金伯利的考驗第3集
programme.desc: 一部探險與求生紀錄片，講述探險家挑戰澳洲極北的「金伯利地區」（Kimberley）的嚴苛故事。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第56集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在台灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第948集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第109集
programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: 絕世情歌第1集
programme.desc: 講述不得志的音樂人文凱帶著外甥女，展開尋找父親的公路之旅，沿途與流浪歌手菲相互扶持，從經典老歌中尋找寫出「絕世情歌」的靈感，兼具台灣美麗海岸景色與動人音樂的成長故事。

programme.title: 二重奏第1集
programme.desc: 在母親罹患胰臟癌末期後，大提琴老師鍾宜的日子便在授課與醫院中往返。一日因看護請假，她不得不親手幫母親換尿布及清理排泄物。在女兒面前尊嚴盡失的鍾母、在母親面前無所適從的鍾宜，這對母女終究因為內在的惶惶不安，在病房內掀起一場風暴。

programme.title: 小貓熊胖達的奇幻冒險第1集
programme.desc: 故事發生在2011年12月聖誕節前夕。患了小胖威利癥的主角胖達，極其愛吃，同學總是利用貪吃這點戲弄他。他的家人也不知道其為罕見疾病，胖達爸爸更是逃避對孩子的愛，埋頭工作。即便如此孩子仍是關心著爸爸，並在聖誕夜為爸爸許了個願望，踏上尋聖誕老公公之旅，展開他的奇幻冒險。

programme.title: 行走TIT第402集
programme.desc: 台灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新台灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 小島同樂繪第1集
programme.desc: 繪本不只是故事，而是一張地圖；地圖也不只是工具，而是一個個熟悉又奇幻華麗的台灣地貌風景。繪本傳承的不僅是文化，更是深藏在文化底下的民族根性。

programme.title: 歐吉桑騎士-阿順阿忠的中年危機第3集
programme.desc: 星馬影帝李銘順、李銘忠兄弟檔首次合體，要騎著台灣最常見的「摩托車」，成為名副其實的「騎士」，用最接地氣的角度，重新認識待超過十年的台灣，探索寶島可愛的人文風景，也找尋自己中年危機的答案。

programme.title: 阮三个第10集
programme.desc: 以在地文化出發，由藝人組成團隊一同經營一間民宿，透過鏡頭記錄他們同居一屋簷下的趣事，以及接待客人、與當地居民搏感情的真實互動。

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第109集
programme.desc: 《公視晚間新聞》因為新聞內容淨化、幾乎看不到其他台灣新聞台的血腥、火爆的場面，且素材多元，針對民生消費、台灣政經社會、人文環境等議題報導都極為深入

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第14集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地了解全球情勢。

programme.title: 一字千金第3集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是台灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能制作公司制作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題并體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，并曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，并以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為范疇。至于答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 也好吃第7集
programme.desc: 與來賓一同造訪街邊小吃、家常料理餐廳，或拜訪各具特色的餐飲職人，從一碗麵、一盤菜出發，細細梳理食物背後的故事、時代脈絡與文化記憶；同時分享簡單易學、人人都能動手嘗試的料理方法，讓觀眾在觀看的同時，自然而然產生「想吃、也想做」的衝動。

programme.title: 彈味中的嬰孩第1集
programme.desc: 《彈味中的嬰孩》故事描述一個在色情養生館工作的越南新住民黎清清，跟丈夫無愛情基礎的她心靈匱乏，與繼女白家家在同屋簷下療癒彼此。某日一神祕客人唐梅軍來到養生館，婚姻及身體都被販賣的黎清清，不禁開始檢視自己的內心所嚮。

programme.title: 九孬第1集
programme.desc: (2020)外省老頭九孬(丁強 飾)“偶遇”歌廳歌女(尹馨 飾)，枯木逢春的溫情讓他甘願接受這場帶有目的的陪伴，不知小家溫情，更對遙遠家鄉情感模糊，一無所有的九孬帶上歌女遠行，可何處是最終歸屬？從未自主過的人生只能在戲謔中繼續茫然度日。

programme.title: 最美的相遇第1集
programme.desc: 剛出生的寶寶提歐被送到社福機構，他的生母自願放棄扶養，並將他交給社福機構安置。就在社福機構盡力幫提歐尋找領養父母時，工作倦怠的尚成為暫時的扶養人，同時，無法生育的艾莉絲也積極的尋找領養機會，就在完善的社福體系以及社工們的努力之下，提歐與艾莉絲的人生終於交會，也連帶影響了每個參與者的生活。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第948集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 全球現場-深度週報第14集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡明易懂的方式解析世界各地的重要新聞，並透過文字圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾理解複雜的國際事務。主要聚焦於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能夠清楚地了解全球局勢。

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第14集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地了解全球情勢。

programme.title: 看公視說英語第8234集
programme.desc: 公共電視與「大家說英語」雜誌合作，製作「看公視說英語」節目，其每日播出的內容均配合雜誌當日教學，透過影像學習英文，深入淺出，是各個年齡層輕鬆學習英語的最佳教材。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2773集
programme.desc: 單元多，可創造明快的節目節奏！不同的單元，猶如一個個不一樣的抽屜，彼此的區隔明確清楚。 多樣的單元，各有各的教育目標及觀賞樂趣。不一樣的孩子可以找到自己喜歡和認同的單元。幼兒的學習並非邏輯式的。單元式的學習方式，更能符合幼兒的學習與發展。綜合雜誌型態的節目類型，可以針對幼兒做全方位的生活學習。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第101集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第73集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原「公視手語新聞」改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目「手語資訊站」，用輕鬆方式「看見」生活新聞資訊。另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元「手語新聞通」，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語。

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第73集
programme.desc: 《公視越南語新聞》是一個針對越南語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在母語中深入了解世界各地的時事動態。

programme.title: 公視印尼語新聞第73集
programme.desc: 《公視印尼語新聞》是一個專注於印尼語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新的印尼本土與國際新聞報導，讓觀眾獲得全球時事、文化和政治等多方面的深入了解與連結。

programme.title: 公視泰語新聞第73集
programme.desc: 《公視泰語新聞》是一個為泰語觀眾製作的新聞節目，提供最即時和全面的國內外新聞報導，讓觀眾深入瞭解泰國和世界各地的時事、政治、經濟、文化等重要議題。

programme.title: 天使的收音機第1集
programme.desc: 因家族遺傳而失去聽力的阿暘（東明相）與輕度聽障的玥雯（嚴藝文）結婚後，生下了女兒星星（吳若湄）。但就在星星國小二年級時，聽力逐漸喪失，只能被迫離開合唱團。阿暘為了女兒，到處奔走籌錢，卻意外被捲入搶運鈔車的計劃並入獄服刑…

programme.title: 舵手第1集
programme.desc: 掌舵人，又稱為舵手，是指駕駛船舶、輪船、帆船、游船、郵輪、艦艇、潛艇、其他類型的海上船只或太空載具的人。在小型船舶上，特別是私人擁有的非商業船只，船長和舵手的功能可以合并為一個人。在較大的船只上，有一名單獨的船副，負責船舶的安全航行并向舵手發出命令。在商船中，舵手通常是一名干練船員，特別是在船舶抵港、離港、限制水域或其他需要精確轉向的情況下操縱舵輪。一名普通海員通常只能在開放水域或安全水域中操縱舵輪。此外，軍艦可能是由船副掌舵。專業舵手需要保持穩定的路線，正確執行所有方向舵命令，并使用與船舶航向和轉向相關的導航術語與艦橋人員溝通。舵手依靠視覺參考、陀螺儀、陀螺羅盤以及舵角指示器來控制穩定的航向

programme.title: 荒野生命力 正面對決第3集
programme.desc: 自然界的獵食動物和牠們的獵物，每天都為了活下去而獵食，或躲避獵殺牠們的天敵。在這場持續不斷的決鬥中，每種生物的生命力都受到嚴峻的考驗。隱藏的能力、強大的體魄或敏銳的思維，都可能瞬間決定生死。皮膚、羽毛、鱗片不僅是一道保護屏障，更是精妙的偽裝，決定每一種動物的命運。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第110集
programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第68集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在台灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 換個爸媽過幾天第25集
programme.desc: 這是一個全新的親子實境節目，主題是探討一個有點衝突的親子關係。父母和孩子都希望改變現狀，為了達到這個目的，他們將參與一個社會實驗。在這個實驗中，孩子將暫時離開父母的身邊，前往接待家庭生活幾天。接下來，可能會發生一些什麼樣的故事呢？

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎麼那麼可愛2第29集
programme.desc: 時間來到2012年，這時的台南知名鳳梨酥店老闆娘蘇林彩香已擁有財富自由、身體堪用、愛情穩定，不再受孩子們感情勒贖。

programme.title: 火車來去第7集
programme.desc: 講述1983年臺南縣，一個平凡而不平庸的小鎮故事，有親情、友情、愛情的酸甜苦澀，鎮上的火車來了，有人上車，遠去他鄉奮鬥、有人下車，回到故鄉探親，火車來去，乘載了人生悲歡離合的故事，串起了你我的記憶。 家的期待是否能成真？來到鎮上的陌生老者王董，跟這一切又有什麼關聯？火車來去，南來北往，是開心啟程還是悵然離鄉？走過火車來去的歲月，滿是鹹酸苦汫的人生。

programme.title: 行走TIT第308集

programme.title: 哈!真相大白了第28集
